n-k-k4-01.title: Isaziso esifinyeziwe
n-k-k4-01.goal: Qhathanisa isifinyezo esifushane somfundi nesaziso somtapo wezincwadi, uthole imigqa eshintsha lokho isaziso esikushoyo, bese ulungisa owodwa wayo.
n-k-k4-01.material:
Umfundi omusha ubuza 현우 ukuthi yimiphi imithetho yomtapo wezincwadi wesikole. 현우 ufunda isaziso esingezansi futhi ubhala isifinyezo esifushane kuye.

[도서관 이용 안내]
- 이용 시간: 평일 오전 9시~오후 5시 / 토요일 오전 9시~낮 12시 / 일요일은 쉽니다.
- 책은 한 번에 5권까지, 2주 동안 빌릴 수 있어요.
- 늦게 반납하면 늦은 날 수만큼 책을 빌릴 수 없어요.
- 음료는 뚜껑이 있는 물병만 가지고 들어갈 수 있어요.
n-k-k4-01.thinking.1: Ukuqhathanisa ikhophi nomthombo wayo umugqa ngomugqa
n-k-k4-01.prereq.1: Wazi 평일, 토요일, 일요일, 빌리다 ne-돌려주다
n-k-k4-01.s.s1.prompt: Isifinyezo sika-현우 singezansi. Eminye imigqa isho into ehlukile esazisweni. Khetha owodwa wayo.
n-k-k4-01.s.s1.hint.0: Thatha isifinyezo umugqa ngomugqa bese uthola umugqa ohambisanayo esazisweni.
n-k-k4-01.s.s1.hint.1: Ngomugqa ngamunye buza: isaziso sisho lokhu ncamashi, noma isifinyezo sishintshile usuku, ubude besikhathi noma isimo?
n-k-k4-01.s.s1.hint.2: Hlola imigqa equkethe usuku, inani lezinsuku noma igama elithi 'noma yini'.
n-k-k4-01.s.s1.explain: Imigqa 2, 5 no-6 ayilungile. Isaziso sithi 일요일은 쉽니다 (kuvaliwe ngeSonto), ukuvinjelwa ukuboleka kuhlala izinsuku ngangokubambezeleka kwencwadi, futhi ibhodlela lamanzi elinesivalo kuphela elivunyelwe. Imigqa 1, 3 no-4 ihambisana nesaziso.
n-k-k4-01.s.s2.prompt: Umugqa wokugcina wesifinyezo uzwakala mfushane futhi unobungane. Kungani uyinkinga kumfundi omusha?
n-k-k4-01.s.s2.hint.0: Beka umugqa 6 eceleni komugqa wokugcina wesaziso.
n-k-k4-01.s.s2.hint.1: Thola igama elincane esazisweni elikhawulela ukuthi yiziphi iziphuzo ezivunyelwe, bese ubona ukuthi isifinyezo sikugcinile yini.
n-k-k4-01.s.s2.o.a: Uzocabanga ukuthi akavunyelwe ukuletha noma yisiphi isiphuzo nhlobo.
n-k-k4-01.s.s2.r.a: Isifinyezo asivimbeli iziphuzo; sivumela zonke iziphuzo, okuyiphutha eliphambene.
n-k-k4-01.s.s2.o.b: Uzocabanga ukuthi iziphuzo ziyavunyelwa ngezinsuku zesonto kuphela.
n-k-k4-01.s.s2.r.b: Isifinyezo asisho lutho ngezinsuku zeziphuzo. Inkinga yisimo esishodayo sokuthi yisiphi isiphuzo.
n-k-k4-01.s.s2.o.c: Angase alethe isiphuzo esingavunyelwe, ngoba isimo salahlwa.
n-k-k4-01.s.s2.o.d: Uzocabanga ukuthi umtapo wezincwadi umvumela ukuletha ukudla kanye neziphuzo.
n-k-k4-01.s.s2.r.d: Umugqa umayelana neziphuzo kuphela; ukudla akusho kuwo.
n-k-k4-01.s.s2.explain: Isifinyezo singaphutha ngaphandle kwegama elilodwa eliphutha: 아무거나 yasusa isimo (뚜껑이 있는 물병만). Izimo ezilahliwe indlela evamile yokushintsha umthetho.
n-k-k4-01.s.s3.prompt: Bhala kabusha umugqa weziphuzo (umugqa wokugcina wesifinyezo) ngesiKorea ukuze usho into efanayo nesaziso. Sebenzisa ulimi lwe--요 olunenhlonipho.
n-k-k4-01.s.s3.hint.0: Buyela emugqeni wokugcina wesaziso bese uthola ukuthi yiziphi iziphuzo ezivunyelwe.
n-k-k4-01.s.s3.hint.1: Yisiphi isimo umugqa wesifinyezo osilahlekele? Siphinde usibuyisele.
n-k-k4-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Umugqa wami ugcina kokubili isivalo nebhodlela lamanzi?
n-k-k4-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Umfundi omusha ofunda umugqa wami kuphela angaletha into efanele?

n-k-k4-02.title: Ikhekhe lamahhala losuku lokuzalwa?
n-k-k4-02.goal: Hlanganisa iflaya nombhalo womngani, ubale ukuthi yimaphi amaqiniso anquma ukuthi uhlelo lusebenza yini, bese utshela umngani wakho ukuthi enze ini.
n-k-k4-02.material:
Namuhla ngu-수요일. Umngani wakho 하나 uthumele umbhalo, futhi ukunike iflaya lekhefi.

[카페 봄날 생일 이벤트]
- 생일인 손님은 케이크 한 조각이 무료예요.
- 생일 3일 전까지 전화로 예약해 주세요. (예: 생일이 금요일이면 화요일까지)
- 일요일은 이벤트를 하지 않아요.
- 신분증을 가지고 오세요.

하나의 문자: "내 생일이 이번 주 토요일이야! 카페 봄날에서 무료 케이크 먹자. 예약은 나중에 할게."
n-k-k4-02.s.s1.prompt: Yimaphi AMAQINISO AMABILI anquma ukuthi uhlelo luka-하나 lusebenza yini? Khetha womabili.
n-k-k4-02.s.s1.hint.0: Yimaphi amaqiniso, lapho ehlanganiswa, anikeza usuku?
n-k-k4-02.s.s1.hint.1: Hlola iqiniso ngalinye: lingenza uhlelo luhluleke ngaphambi kokuba 하나 afinyelele ekhefini?
n-k-k4-02.s.s1.r.b: Usuku lokuzalwa luka-하나 ngoMgqibelo, ngakho umthetho weSonto awubalulekile kulolu hlelo.
n-k-k4-02.s.s1.r.d: Lokhu kumele kwenziwe ekhefini, kodwa akunquli ukuthi uhlelo lusengasebenza yini.
n-k-k4-02.s.s1.r.e: Lesi yisizathu sohlelo, hhayi umthetho okumele uwuhlole.
n-k-k4-02.s.s1.explain: Umthetho wokubhukha nosuku lokuzalwa kumele kuhlanganiswe: usuku lokuzalwa lwangoMgqibelo kanye no-'kuze kube izinsuku ezingu-3 ngaphambili' kunikeza isikhathi sokugcina, futhi isikhathi sokugcina singase sisondele.
n-k-k4-02.s.s2.prompt: Sebenzisa isibonelo seflaya. Namuhla ngu-수요일. Ngosuku lokuzalwa lwangoMgqibelo, yimuphi usuku lokugcina lokubhukha?
n-k-k4-02.s.s2.hint.0: Sebenzisa isibonelo eflayeni njengephethini: kusuka osukwini lokuzalwa, bala emuva inani elifanayo lezinsuku.
n-k-k4-02.s.s2.hint.1: Bhala izinsuku ngokulandelana uMgqibelo, uLwesihlanu, uLwesine, ... bese umisa enanini elifanele.
n-k-k4-02.s.s2.r.a: ULwesine lungu-2 izinsuku kuphela ngaphambi koMgqibelo, ngakho sekuvele kuphuzile.
n-k-k4-02.s.s2.r.c: ULwesibili lungu-4 izinsuku ngaphambi koMgqibelo. Bala ngesibonelo: Usuku lokuzalwa lwangoLwesihlanu lunikeza uLwesibili.
n-k-k4-02.s.s2.r.d: UMsombuluko ungu-5 izinsuku ngaphambi koMgqibelo; isibonelo seflaya (usuku lokuzalwa lwangoLwesihlanu, uLwesibili) sibonisa izinsuku ezingu-3 ngaphambili.
n-k-k4-02.s.s2.explain: Kusuka ngoLwesihlanu kuya ngoLwesibili kungu-3 izinsuku ngaphambili, ngakho kusuka ngoMgqibelo kuya ngoLwesithathu ibanga elifanayo. Namuhla ngoLwesithathu, ngakho namuhla yilusuku lokugcina.
n-k-k4-02.s.s3.prompt: Bhala umbhalo omfushane ku-하나 ngesiKorea (ulimi lwe--요 lobungane). Mtshele ukuthi enze ini nangaphambi kwini, nokuthi kungani.
n-k-k4-02.s.s3.hint.1: Sho lokho okumele akwenze (ini, kanjani) bese wengeza isizathu nge--아서/-어서 noma -니까.
n-k-k4-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Umbhalo wami usho namuhla, okumele kwenziwe nesizathu?
n-k-k4-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: 하나 wayezazi ukuthi enze ini ngemva kokuwufunda?

n-k-k4-03.title: Amathikithi eqembu
n-k-k4-03.goal: Guqula umlayezo womngani onomthetho ofihliwe wesilinganiso ube yizimo ezinembile, wakhe amaqembu amaningana afanelayo, bese ubika elilodwa ngesiKorea.
n-k-k4-03.material:
Umngani wakho 서연 ukuthumelela umbhalo ngaphambi kokuthenga amathikithi epaki yokuzijabulisa:

"놀이공원에 같이 가요. 어른 한 명이 어린이 두 명까지 데리고 갈 수 있대요. 어린이도 한 명은 가야 해요. 모두 5명 이상 가고 싶어요. 표값은 모두 합쳐서 6만 원까지 쓸 수 있어요."

(1만 원 = 10,000원, ngakho 6만 원 = 60,000원. Iqembu linabadala nezingane obabhalile kuphela.)

[표값]
어른 한 명: 10,000원
어린이 한 명: 6,000원
n-k-k4-03.prereq.1: Uyazi izinombolo, 명, 어른, 어린이 ne--까지
n-k-k4-03.prereq.2: Uyazi i-만 (10,000) emanani afana no-3만 8천 원
n-k-k4-03.s.s1.prompt: I-'어른 한 명이 어린이 두 명까지 데리고 갈 수 있대요' ikutshela ini?
n-k-k4-03.s.s1.hint.0: Zama umthetho nomuntu omdala oyedwa kuqala: bangaki abantwana abangeza?
n-k-k4-03.s.s1.hint.1: Bese uzama abantu abadala ababili ubone ukuthi inani likhula kanjani.
n-k-k4-03.s.s1.o.a: Umuntu omdala oyedwa angathatha abantwana abangafika kwababili.
n-k-k4-03.s.s1.o.b: Umuntu omdala ngamunye kumele athathe abantwana ababili ngqo.
n-k-k4-03.s.s1.r.b: I-'까지' inikeza umkhawulo ophezulu, hhayi inani elidingekayo.
n-k-k4-03.s.s1.o.c: Kungaba nabantwana abalinganayo nabantu abadala kuphela.
n-k-k4-03.s.s1.r.c: Umthetho uthi abantwana ababili kumuntu omdala ngamunye, hhayi oyedwa.
n-k-k4-03.s.s1.o.d: Ingane ngayinye idinga abantu abadala ababili ukuhamba nayo.
n-k-k4-03.s.s1.r.d: Lokho kuhlehlisa umthetho: lapha umuntu omdala oyedwa angathatha abantwana ababili.
n-k-k4-03.s.s1.explain: I-'-까지' ibeka umkhawulo: umuntu omdala oyedwa uthatha abantwana abafika kwababili, ngakho ngabantu abadala abangu-2 abantwana abafika ku-4 bangahamba.
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.prompt: Thola amaqembu angu-3 afanelana nazo zonke izimo zomlayezo, ngalinye linenani elihlukile labantu abadala. a = abantu abadala, c = abantwana.
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala izimo ngamazwi akho kuqala, umugqa owodwa ngasinye.
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.hint.1: Qala nge-a = 2 bese ufuna izinombolo zabantwana ezanelisa umthetho wabantwana nomthetho wabantu abangu-5.
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.ok.c1: Okungenani umuntu omdala oyedwa nengane eyodwa.
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.fail.c1: Udinga okungenani umuntu omdala oyedwa, futhi umlayezo uthi okungenani ingane eyodwa (어린이도 한 명은).
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.ok.c2: Akungabi ngaphezu kwabantwana ababili kumuntu omdala ngamunye.
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Abantwana abaningi kakhulu: umuntu omdala ngamunye angathatha abafika kwababili (어린이 두 명까지).
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.fail.c3: Umlayezo ufuna abantu abangu-5 noma ngaphezulu (모두 5명 이상).
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.explain: Isibonelo abantu abadala abangu-2 + abantwana abangu-3 = ama-won angu-38,000; 3 + 3 = 48,000 won; 4 + 2 = 52,000 won. Amaqembu amaningi ayafaneleka ngoba umlayezo unikeza imikhawulo, hhayi iqembu elilodwa ngqo.
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.because.prompt: Khetha iQEMBU ELILODWA lakho bese uthumela 서연 umbhalo omfushane wesiKorea (-요 enenhlonipho): kuqala abantu abadala, bese abantwana, bese inani eliphelele. Bhala izinombolo njengamadijithi noma amagama ezinombolo zesiKorea.
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.because.hint.0: Sebenzisa iqembu elilodwa ongenhla: yiziphi izinombolo ezimbili?
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.because.hint.1: Sho abantu abadala, bese abantwana, bese isamba nge-won.
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ingabe izinombolo zombhalo wami zihambisana neqembu elilodwa engilakhile?
n-k-k4-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ingabe isamba singu-10,000 × abantu abadala + 6,000 × abantwana?
n-k-k4-03.s.s3.prompt: Umzala ka-서연 uphakamisa: '어른 5명이랑 어린이 2명이 가요. 모두 7명이고 5만 8천 원이에요.' Lolu hlelo luphula yimuphi umthetho?
n-k-k4-03.s.s3.hint.0: Hlola uhlelo ngazo zonke izimo zomlayezo, olulodwa ngesikhathi.
n-k-k4-03.s.s3.hint.1: Yenza ukubala ngakunye wena; ungathembeli ezinombolweni ezibhalwe kuhlelo.
n-k-k4-03.s.s3.r.a: Abantu abadala abahlanu bangathatha abantwana abafika kwabayishumi, futhi uhlelo lunababili kuphela.
n-k-k4-03.s.s3.r.b: Kunabantu abangu-7, ngakho umthetho wabantu abangu-5 uyanelisiwe.
n-k-k4-03.s.s3.r.c: Uhlelo lunabantwana abangu-2, ngakho umthetho wokungenani ingane eyodwa uyanelisiwe.
n-k-k4-03.s.s3.o.d: Amathikithi empeleni abiza ama-won angu-62,000, ngaphezu komkhawulo.
n-k-k4-03.s.s3.explain: Abantu abadala abahlanu babiza ama-won angu-50,000 nabantwana ababili babiza ama-won angu-12,000, okungama-won angu-62,000, ngaphezu kuka-60,000. Inombolo kuhlelo yayingalungile. Njalo phinda ubale isamba wena esikhundleni sokukopa.

n-k-k4-04.title: Isimemo sokudla okulula
n-k-k4-04.goal: Funda ingxoxo emfushane ngezigaba, shintsha ukufunda kwakho njengoba imisho emisha ifika, bese uphendula ukuze kungabikho oqagelayo.
n-k-k4-04.material: Usendaweni yokudlela yesikole nomfundi osebenza naye 지우. Ukhipha isikhwama sama-crackers.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.prompt: Funda ingxenye ngayinye, khetha ukufunda okubonakala kunokwenzeka kakhulu, bese uqhubeka.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.hint.1: Funa amagama anikeza isizathu noma isikhathi ngemuva kwempendulo yokuqala.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Kokubili ukufunda kungenzeka: i-괜찮아요 ingamukela noma yenqabe isimemo. Impendulo emfushane eyodwa ayanele.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Akukho okhuluma ngokunye ukudla okulula; uphendula kuphela isimemo sakho.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Impendulo yakhe imfushane futhi inenhlonipho, hhayi umbuzo.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.1.after: I-'-아서요' inikeza isizathu. Ukudla kakhulu ekudleni kwasemini kwenza 'cha ngiyabonga' kube ukufunda okungcono.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Angathanda ama-crackers, ngoba wadla kakhulu ekudleni kwasemini.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Ukudla okukhulu kwasemini kuyisizathu sokungadli ngaphezulu, ngakho kukhomba ukunqaba.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Uphendula ngesizathu esixhumene nokudla, ngakho uyizwile.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.2.after: Manje lonke isithombe sicacile: cha okwamanje, mhlawumbe yebo kamuva. I-괜찮아요 yokuqala yodwa ibingakwazi ukukhombisa lokho.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Hhayi manje, kodwa mhlawumbe i-cracker eyodwa kamuva.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ucela eyodwa kamuva, ngakho akanqabi unomphela.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Ucela eyodwa kamuva, ngakho ufuna ukuthi uwagcine.
n-k-k4-04.s.s1.reflect: I-괜찮아요 ingasho 'yebo, kulungile' noma 'cha ngiyabonga'. Amagama alandela (isizathu, isikhathi) anquma ukuthi yiyiphi. Impendulo enenhlonipho ingaba nje ingacacile.
n-k-k4-04.s.s2.prompt: Umngane wakho 민호 ukunikeza ukudla okulula. Iyiphi impendulo 민호 angayiqonda kabi kalula kakhulu?
n-k-k4-04.s.s2.hint.0: Buza kuyo yonke impendulo: ngemuva kokuyifunda, 민호 angazi yini ukuthi uzokunikeza ukudla okulula manje?
n-k-k4-04.s.s2.hint.1: Cabanga impendulo ngayinye kumlayezo wombhalo ongenawo umsindo wezwi: 민호 angayifunda ngezindlela ezimbili eziphambene?
n-k-k4-04.s.s2.explain: I-괜찮아요 yodwa ingezwakala njengo-yebo noma cha. Ukunqaba noma ukwamukela ngegama elicacile (안 먹을게요, 주세요) akunakwenzeka.
n-k-k4-04.s.s3.prompt: 민호 ukunikeza ukudla okulula. Awufuni manje, kodwa ungase ufune kamuva. Phendula ngesiKorea (inkulumo enenhlonipho nge--요) ukuze 민호 angaqondi kabi.
n-k-k4-04.s.s3.hint.0: Sho ngokucacile ukuthi awuzukudla manje futhi unikeze isizathu esifushane.
n-k-k4-04.s.s3.hint.1: Engeza omunye umusho mayelana nalokho ongakwenza kamuva.
n-k-k4-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe 민호 angazi ukuthi ngithi cha manje?
n-k-k4-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe 민호 angazi ukuthi ngingase ngithi yebo kamuva?
n-k-k4-04.s.s3.modelNote.0: Unqaba manje, unikeza isizathu, ucela kamuva.

n-k-k4-05.title: Ekhaya sekwephuzile: uhlelo olulodwa, abafundi ababili
n-k-k4-05.goal: Sho izindaba ezifanayo kugogo wakho nakumfowenu omncane, ushintsha izinga lolimi lwesiKorea kwelilodwa ngalinye.
n-k-k4-05.material: Unomkhuba weklabhu namuhla futhi uzobe usekhaya ngo-7:00, sekwephuzile kunokujwayelekile. Uzoshiyela ugogo wakho (할머니) inothi, nomfowenu omncane (동생) umlayezo, ozosebenzisa naye i-반말.
n-k-k4-05.s.s1.hint.0: Funda imilayezo umusho owodwa ngesikhathi bese uhlola ukuthi umusho ngamunye uphela kanjani.
n-k-k4-05.s.s1.hint.1: Hlola isenzo esisetshenziselwa isidlo sakusihlwa sika-할머니 kanye nokuphela.
n-k-k4-05.s.s1.r.a: Yomibili imisho iphela ngendlela okhuluma ngayo nomngane noma nomuntu omncane, hhayi no-할머니.
n-k-k4-05.s.s1.r.c: Umusho wokuqala ushelelela ekukhulunyweni kwensuku zonke (올게); imisho emibili ayihambisani.
n-k-k4-05.s.s1.r.d: Inenhlonipho, kodwa i-먹어요 ayihloniphi 할머니 njengoba i-드세요 ihlonipha ukudla kwakhe.
n-k-k4-05.s.s1.explain: Ku-할머니 yonke imisho idinga i--요 noma ukuphela okuhloniphekile, futhi ukudla kwakhe kuthatha isenzo esihloniphekile i-드세요. Ukuphela kwensuku zonke (가, 먹어, 올게) kwabangani nabantu abancane, futhi ukuxuba amazinga enothini eyodwa kuzwakala njengokunganaki.
n-k-k4-05.s.s2.prompt: Bhala inothi lakho ku-할머니 ngesiKorea. Sho ukuthi uzobe usekhaya ngo-7:00 nokuthi kungani.
n-k-k4-05.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ngokubiza 할머니, bese ushiwo isikhathi nesizathu.
n-k-k4-05.s.s2.hint.1: Qeda umusho ngamunye ngokuphela kwe--요 noma i--세요.
n-k-k4-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ngikhulume ku-할머니 futhi ngaqeda yonke imisho ngenhlonipho?
n-k-k4-05.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingabe izindaba (7:00 nokuthi kungani) zikhona zonke?
n-k-k4-05.s.s3.prompt: Manje bhala umlayezo kumfowenu omncane (동생), nge-반말. Sho izindaba ezifanayo: uzobe usekhaya ngo-7:00. Engeza into eyodwa ofuna ayenze.
n-k-k4-05.s.s3.hint.0: Sho isikhathi esifanayo, kodwa sebenzisa ukuphela osisebenzisa no-동생.
n-k-k4-05.s.s3.hint.1: Engeza isicelo esisodwa esifushane (먹어, 해 줘, 기다려 ...).
n-k-k4-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe konke ukuphela kwami kwensuku zonke?
n-k-k4-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe iphethe izindaba ezifanayo nenothi ku-할머니?
